svg.aria-label: Inviting users. A new person has a TIBCO account or a corporate account. TIBCO accounts get an email invite and work on TIBCO SaaS only. Corporate accounts come through a SAML identity provider such as Okta or Entra ID, valid on SaaS and self-hosted, or through LDAP, self-hosted only. Legacy on prem users are re-mapped to corporate accounts. Every path ends in the same permission wizard and the same four roles.
